claims.statement: The Machinery Regulation applies mandatorily from 20 January 2027 and expressly addresses AI-powered safety functions and cyber-safety of relevant controls.
Before market placement or service, manufacturers must compile technical documentation, perform the relevant conformity procedure, issue the declaration and retain records for at least ten years.
Demand hypothesis: integrators will pay to make the exact commissioned configuration, rather than a generic template, the release control point.

contrary_evidence: Established machinery-safety consultants already sell technical-file services.
Low-volume integrators may manage documentation in ordinary project folders.

economics.acquisition_route: Hypothesis: safety assessors, PLC vendors and automation associations refer integrators at commissioning
economics.founder_net_worth_path: Hypothesis: 250 integrators averaging 30000 PLN recurring annual revenue plus handovers could exceed 9m PLN annual revenue and support founder equity above 5m PLN in 5-7 years
economics.founder_time: 14-20 hours weekly with a machinery-safety contractor
economics.gross_margin_basis: Economics hypothesis: 68-82% blended margin because specialist review remains human
economics.payback: Hypothesis: 8-13 months with ten integrators and two managed handovers monthly
economics.pricing: Economics hypothesis: 1000-2500 PLN per engineer monthly plus 4000-15000 PLN per managed handover
economics.retention_or_repeat: Every new machine, retrofit, safety update and later owner modification

fingerprint.compounding_advantage: Integrator-specific component libraries, accepted evidence patterns and machine lineage shorten every later retrofit
fingerprint.customer: Polish automation integrators and SME machine builders delivering customised production equipment
fingerprint.distribution_mechanism: Embedded in automation integrator commissioning checklists and safety-assessor referrals
fingerprint.offer_and_business_model: Versioned change-control and technical-file release SaaS with optional specialist review
fingerprint.payer_and_paid_event: Integrator pays per engineer seat and per machine handover file; complex projects add managed review
fingerprint.problem_trigger: Controls, safety logic or AI features change before handover and the accountable conformity file must match the commissioned machine

founder_fit: Quantitative risk and software provenance fit technical strengths
Regional industrial base is accessible from Warsaw and Wielkopolska
Channel and project workflow reduces high-energy prospecting
risks: Safety liability if users over-rely on automated suggestions
Highly varied machinery makes template reuse difficult

structure.control_point: The final integrator-to-owner handover packet before production use
structure.critical_dependency: Integrator adoption and access to qualified safety experts or notified bodies for gated categories

thesis: An automation-integrator-embedded handover system could capture the risk analysis, safety-control changes, software logic provenance, tests and declaration inputs for each materially modified or newly built machine before commissioning. It would coordinate competent parties and notified bodies where required, not certify machinery. Demand and economics are hypotheses.
title: Machinery Retrofit Change-Control File
uncertainties: Frequency and cost of current handover failures
